title: 第9章 暴打唐傲天第10章 气运之子李正通
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
唐傲天走出人群，不屑的看着秦宇。
“庶民，多谢你给的这次机会。”
秦宇看上去瘦瘦小小，一副弱不禁风的样子，平时饭都不一定吃饱，更别说练武了。
而他唐傲天可不一样，为了打好修仙基础，他有着专业的武术老师，每天都要练武一刻钟。
战斗力相当彪悍。
就秦宇这样的，他能打十个！
秦宇懒得搭理他，直接看向二长老，“现在可以打了吗？”
他早已摩拳擦掌，等候多时。
之前唐傲天插队时，秦宇就想揍他。
但奈何当时条件不允许，只能就此作罢。
本想着等进宗门后再揍也不迟，但没想到唐傲天竟然被淘汰了。
就在秦宇以为这辈子都没机会揍他时，唐傲天主动站了出来，给秦宇创造了一个绝佳的机会。
不想挨揍的人秦宇见多了，但想办法找揍的人秦宇还是第一次见。
秦宇指关节咯吱作响，拳头一般大的拳头早已饥渴难耐。
二长老点点头，“开始吧！”
‘给我狠狠的打！
’二长老在心中想道。
得到指令，秦宇直接朝唐傲天走了过去。
而唐傲天则是摆出专业的架势，身体还在不断的左右摇摆。
“弱智！”

秦宇走过去，直接把手里的一把土丢到唐傲天脸上。
“卑鄙，我的眼睛！”
唐傲天闭上双眼，手还没来的及去揉，秦宇的拳头便直接砸到他的脸上。
砰~
一声闷响，唐傲天应声倒地。
秦宇直接压在唐傲天身上，一拳接着一拳的朝着唐傲天脸上招呼。
砰~
啊~
砰砰~
啊啊~
砰砰砰~
啊啊啊~
拳头落下的声音和唐傲天的惨叫声交相辉映。
不一会儿，唐傲天便脸部浮肿、头破血流，惨叫声更是变成呜咽声，一双腿不断倒腾，不知道是心中不服输的精神驱使，还是因为疼痛而抽搐。
“让你插队！”
砰~
“让你一口一个庶民！”
砰~
content_en:
Tang Aotian walked out of the crowd and looked at Qin Yu with disdain.
"Common people, thank you for this opportunity."
Qin Yu looked thin and frail. He didn't always have enough food, let alone practice martial arts.
But Tang Aotian is different. In order to lay a solid foundation for cultivating immortals, he has a professional martial arts teacher and practices martial arts for a quarter of an hour every day.
The combat effectiveness is quite strong.
Just like Qin Yu, he can fight ten!
Qin Yu was too lazy to answer him and looked directly at the second elder, "Can we fight now?"
He has been gearing up and waiting for a long time.
When Tang Aotian jumped in line before, Qin Yu wanted to beat him.
However, conditions did not allow it at the time, so we had to give up.
I thought it wouldn't be too late to beat him after he entered the sect, but he didn't expect Tang Aotian to be eliminated.
Just when Qin Yu thought he would never have a chance to beat him up in his life, Tang Aotian stepped forward and created an excellent opportunity for Qin Yu.
Qin Yu has seen many people who don't want to be beaten, but this is the first time he has seen someone who wants to be beaten.
Qin Yu's knuckles crackled, and his fist as big as a fist was already hungry and thirsty.
The second elder nodded, "Let's begin!"
‘Hit me hard!
’ The second elder thought in his heart.
After receiving the instruction, Qin Yu walked directly towards Tang Aotian.
Tang Aotian, on the other hand, put on a professional posture, his body still swaying from side to side.
"Retarded!"
Qin Yu walked over and threw a handful of dirt into Tang Aotian's face.
"Despicable, my eyes!"
Tang Aotian closed his eyes. Before he could rub his hands, Qin Yu's fist hit him directly in the face.
Bang~
There was a muffled sound, and Tang Aotian fell to the ground.
Qin Yu pressed directly on Tang Aotian, punching Tang Aotian's face one after another.
Bang~
Ah~
Bang bang~
Ahh~
Bang bang bang~
Ahhhh~
The sound of fists falling echoed with Tang Aotian's screams.
After a while, Tang Aotian's face became swollen, his head was bleeding, his screams turned into whimpers, and his legs kept tumbling. He didn't know whether it was driven by the spirit of reluctance in his heart or because of the pain.
"Let you jump in line!"
Bang~
"I'll make you a commoner!"
Bang~
